instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Managed IT services provider offering helpdesk, network management, cybersecurity monitoring, and cloud migration services to 150+ SME clients. With a 24/7 NOC staffed by 18 technicians and operating across multiple geographies, the firm maintains operational continuity through robust service delivery protocols.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is not a formalized function in our organization. We occasionally try new tools or workflows when a team member champions them, but these are isolated, grassroots efforts without executive sponsorship, budget allocation, or structured measurement of outcomes. This ad-hoc approach has resulted in scattered, unmeasured experiments.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.additionalContext: The SME IT service market is highly competitive and driven by price sensitivity, necessitating continuous operational optimization to maintain margins against larger competitors.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: Automated Ticket Routing and Triage System
opportunities.rationale: Implementing basic AI/ML to categorize incoming helpdesk tickets will reduce manual sorting time for technicians, allowing them to focus on complex issue resolution. This addresses the core efficiency goal by optimizing existing labor resources without requiring a full system overhaul.

first_actions: Select and pilot low-cost automation tool compatible with current ticketing software.
Define clear KPIs focused on reduced average ticket handling time.
resources_needed: License cost for existing platform integration
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) by 15% within the first quarter.
milestones: Full rollout of routing logic across all 18 technicians by Q3

opportunities.title: Cloud Resource Utilization Optimization Tooling
opportunities.rationale: Develop or acquire lightweight tooling to identify and decommission underutilized cloud instances (IaaS/PaaS). This directly targets cost drivers by ensuring the company only pays for what is actively used, providing a rapid ROI path.

first_actions: Conduct an immediate audit of cloud resource allocation across all business units.
Prototype automated reporting dashboard linking usage metrics to potential savings.
resources_needed: Cloud engineering hours for initial script development
Zero capital expenditure required (SaaS or open-source solutions preferred)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a verifiable 10% reduction in monthly cloud operational spend within six months.
milestones: Baseline utilization report generated by Month 1
Deployment of optimization scripts and validation by Month 4

opportunities.title: Internal Knowledge Base and Playbook System (KM)
opportunities.rationale: Centralizing technical documentation, troubleshooting steps, and successful project playbooks will reduce the reliance on tribal knowledge residing with specific senior technicians. This initiative improves talent utilization and reduces training time.

first_actions: Establish a mandatory weekly contribution schedule for all tech staff to update SOPs.
Select a simple, easy-to-use internal documentation platform.
resources_needed: Time allocation from operational staff for documentation
Subscription cost for the chosen KM software (minimal)
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease average time spent on knowledge retrieval tasks by 20% in six months.
milestones: Core SOP library established by Month 3
System fully integrated into the internal service management platform

next_steps.action: Form a cross-functional task force (Operations, Finance, IT) to prioritize and scope the top two efficiency opportunities.
Develop detailed business cases for the automated ticket routing pilot project, including ROI projections.
Audit current cloud spending baseline and identify immediate opportunities for waste elimination before Q3 budget approval.

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process leading to uncoordinated, isolated efforts.
High reliance on individual talent rather than standardized knowledge management systems.
Bottlenecks in decision-making due to the formal committee structure and slow ROI gating.
